definitions.explanation: A portable device combining a radio and cassette tape player/recorder. Short for ラジオカセット. While the technology is outdated, the word appears in older learning materials.

examples.japanese: ラジカセ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listened to English tapes on a radio cassette player.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ラジカセ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Radio cassette players used to be popular.

examples.japanese: ラジカセ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{録音|ろくおん}→録音：05107_rokuon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I recorded my favorite songs on the radio cassette player and listened to them over and over.

notes:
ラジカセ is an abbreviation of ラジオカセット, combining the loanwords "radio" and "cassette." It refers to a portable boombox-style device.

ETYMOLOGY:
Popular in the 1980s-90s, ラジカセ has been largely replaced by ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧ and digital players. The word still appears in older JLPT vocabulary lists and may come up in conversations about past technology or nostalgia.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ラジカセ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to listen on a radio cassette player
- ラジカセ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{録音|ろくおん}→録音：05107_rokuon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to record on a radio cassette player
